original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

actual_scope: Optimize the complete PR3773 scientific consumer by Gray-code enumeration of every nonzero core functional, preserving source checks and exact output.

bottleneck_link: A faster complete geometry replay reduces the cost of checking this fixed decoder ingredient. It does not improve a supplier bill or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop at the first verified complete-consumer wall-time improvement; no second optimization or larger geometry census.
evidence: PROOF.md and verify.py establish exact mask-table equivalence; benchmark.py records five alternating fresh-process pairs with identical complete stdout and zero failures.
